title: Run a mechanical duct between two points on a level
task: Create a mechanical Duct between two XYZ points on a level, using Duct.Create with a MechanicalSystemType and a DuctType, and read its length back. Covers MEP duct modelling.

pitfalls.symptom: First() throws InvalidOperationException 'Sequence contains no elements' when collecting MechanicalSystemType or DuctType.
pitfalls.cause: The open document was created from a template with no MEP content, so it has no mechanical system types or duct types loaded.
pitfalls.fix: Confirm the FilteredElementCollector for MechanicalSystemType and DuctType is non-empty before calling First(); use a Mechanical/Systems template or load MEP families first.
